name: Breadcrumb
label: Breadcrumb
description: Hierarchical navigation trail showing the user's location within the site.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Maximum visible items before collapsing (min 2: first + last)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Legacy accessible-name prop for the nav landmark.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component its links render with, such as Next.js's `Link`, so they
navigate through the app's router; a plain `<a>` when unset. This
component can render on the server, so it never reads a LinkProvider:
pass the prop even under one.
